nodes.rationale: Queue lives in Postgres so nothing else to install; procrastinate schema is a frozen SQL copy run by an Alembic revision, upgrades add new revisions rather than editing it.

nodes.label: Backup and restore
nodes.rationale: Metadata-driven (OWNED/CHILDREN/EXCLUDED) so new columns back up automatically and a test forces a decision on new tables; restore only into an empty account with new ids so one file can go into two accounts without collisions; everything rolls back on any problem.

nodes.label: Balance snapshots
nodes.rationale: Past days are stored with the rate they had, so revaluing an account never rewrites history; snapshots are repaired via a dirty table when older transactions change because balances derived from transactions remain the source of truth.

nodes.label: Email digest (SMTP mailer)
nodes.rationale: Standard-library SMTP, no new dependency; on only when SMTP_HOST and SMTP_FROM are set; WINDOW of two days so enabling it sends no backlog.

nodes.label: Notifications
nodes.rationale: Derived, never entered: dedupe_key unique per user so re-syncing never repeats; dismiss keeps the row so it is not announced again; sync time noted when a look finishes to avoid a parallel read before commit; writing a transaction clears the throttle.

nodes.label: The seed (app/seed.py)
nodes.rationale: Builds a realistic first month rather than random volume so the dashboard is never empty.

nodes.label: Short numbers (compact_numbers)
nodes.rationale: formatMoney is the single function every amount goes through; the exact figure is always a hover or tap away via FullAmountTip; module-state preference is a known cosmetic risk for multi-user servers.

nodes.label: Compare (period vs period)
nodes.rationale: Needs no API of its own: calls /transactions/categories twice; default is Last month since early in a month 'this month' is nearly empty.

nodes.label: Money flow (Sankey)
nodes.rationale: Built in the browser from existing category totals; Saved/Overspent nodes balance both sides so they always add up.

nodes.label: Net worth drivers
nodes.rationale: Five drivers (income, spending, adjustments, transfers, exchange_rates) always add up exactly because exchange_rates is the remainder; waterfall axis is the change since start so steps are not dwarfed.

nodes.label: Trends (category-by-month table)
nodes.rationale: Shares _category_buckets with /transactions/categories so the rules cannot drift apart; cell shade is never the only signal.

nodes.label: Bills whose amount varies (amount_varies)
nodes.rationale: Planned payments are estimates; the real amount/rate/base cost is entered when paid, and the next estimate copies the last real payment.

nodes.label: Subscriptions plan their next payment
nodes.rationale: Planned transactions are the schedule; planned_through means deleting a planned payment skips that cycle permanently; sync is idempotent and runs on read so no worker is needed.

nodes.label: Suggested subscriptions (candidate detection)
nodes.rationale: Worked out each time, never stored; accept re-detects on the server from vendor_id and currency rather than trusting client ids; only high-confidence ones notify so a loose guess never nags.

nodes.label: Attachments (receipts)
nodes.rationale: Type decided from file bytes so SVG/HTML cannot pose as images; file written first then row, failed insert deletes the file; orphan cleanup only via the daily job.

nodes.label: Transaction groups
nodes.rationale: A group changes nothing else; 2 to 50 members, undersized groups dissolve; no list filter by group because it would need threading through six routes.

nodes.label: Linking two transactions into one transfer
nodes.norm_label: linking two transactions into one transfer
nodes.rationale: The scan only suggests; nothing merges until the user confirms; the expense becomes the transfer and the income is trashed so undo is restore plus edit.

nodes.label: Locations and the Places map
nodes.rationale: Radius clustering replaced a fixed grid that split spots at cell edges; tiles are the operator's choice for privacy.

nodes.label: Place search (geocoder)
nodes.rationale: Only sends typed text on explicit search, paced 1.1s apart per Nominatim policy, cached an hour and rate limited; the API calls it so User-Agent and pacing hold.

nodes.label: Refunds (refund_of_id)
nodes.rationale: A refund is income with refund_of_id, no new type; it is money back for spending so wherever spending is summed it subtracts; a refunded purchase is locked so links hold.

nodes.label: Transaction templates
nodes.rationale: Exchange rate deliberately not stored (the form suggests the day's market rate); all links SET NULL so a template never blocks deletion.

nodes.label: Web links on a transaction
nodes.rationale: Separate table so links are in backups unlike files; server never fetches a link, so no SSRF.
